_comment: Limits for the oracle-arm-free target (Always-Free Ampere A1 aarch64). Default single-instance shape: 1 OCPU / 6 GB. Users running the full 4 OCPU / 24 GB Always-Free quota in one instance get higher RAM at runtime via deputyctl doctor's live probe. Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs.

limitations.reason: Oracle reclaims Always-Free instances after ~7 days of idle (per their published policy). Reclaimed instances lose data unless backed up.
limitations.unblock: enable the keepalive opt-in in the wizard (M3+); pay for a non-Always-Free shape; or take regular deputyctl backups to B2/R2

limitations.reason: Oracle Cloud instances have no audio device; voice features disabled
limitations.unblock: deploy on rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for voice

limitations.reason: Oracle custom images are single-slot; rollback is via custom-image versioning + snapshot recreate
limitations.unblock: keep the prior custom-image version pinned in OCI; deputyctl update creates a new image rev

limitations.reason: Default 1 OCPU / 6 GB single-instance shape sits below comfortable local-LLM headroom; OK for embeddings/rerank only
limitations.unblock: scale to 4 OCPU / 24 GB single-instance shape (still Always-Free quota); 3B models work, slower than rpi5 short tasks
